system/script/environment/print.runtime_source: RouterOS 7.25.1 API/REST /system/script/environment/print with a public tf725Probe global

scope: RouterOS 7.25.1 support. The official 7.24-to-7.25 comparison supplies the release-addition inventory; earlier RouterOS versions are unsupported. Hardware runtime validation is separate.

runtime_overrides.routing/pimsm/instance: 7.25.1 API and REST reject comment despite the generic list-menu documentation
runtime_overrides.ip/ssh/known-hosts: 7.25.1 supports add/remove/print but rejects set: configured fields require replacement
runtime_overrides.tool/fetch: output and keep-result conflict, even if keep-result is false
runtime_overrides.interface/ethernet/pon: 7.25.1 console/inspect confirms set accepts name, status and olt-max-mtu; status is not a read-only flag in this menu
runtime_overrides.routing/pimsm/interface-template: 7.25.1 console/inspect add/set arguments do not include comment
runtime_overrides.routing/pimsm/igmp-interface-template: 7.25.1 console/inspect add/set arguments do not include comment
runtime_overrides.interface/eoipv6: 7.25.1 add/set accepts comment; dscp is a numeric-or-inherit string (default inherit), despite the reference num type; mtu likewise accepts numeric-or-auto strings (default auto)
